OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 9a-g)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. An applicant or interested citizen who wishes to appeal any Planning Commission decision (Items #9a-g) may file an appeal with the City Clerk's office within 15 days after the date of the Planning Commission's decision. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.

Adoption on Second Reading of Ordinance 17-725; an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates Amending Title 18 of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code in Order to Expressly Ban Commercial (Medical and Non-Medical) Marijuana Activities, Allow for the Delivery of Medical Marijuana, Reasonably Regulate Indoor Cultivation of Marijuana for Personal Use, and Ban All Outdoor Cultivation of Marijuana; and Amending Section 8.56.020 (Smoking Prohibited) to Include Additional Locations Where Smoking is Prohibited in Light of Current State Laws Regarding Recreational Marijuana Use
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance 17-725; an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates amending Title 18 of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code amending Title 18 of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code in order to expressly ban commercial (medical and non-medical) marijuana activities, allow for the delivery of medical marijuana, reasonably regulate indoor cultivation of marijuana for personal use, and ban all outdoor cultivation of marijuana; and amending Section 8.56.020 (Smoking Prohibited) to include additional locations where smoking is prohibited in light of current State laws regarding recreational marijuana use.

12.
Discussion of Potential Ballot Measure for Providing Direction to Schedule a Public Hearing that Calls for an Election
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council review the attached Resolutions and Ordinance, and provide direction and wording modifications for calendaring a Public Hearing at the City Council meeting on January 10, 2018 calling for an election on April 10, 2018.
Staff Report
13.
Approval of Amendment #1 to Professional Services Agreement with Gladwell Governmental Services, Inc., a Professional Services Agreement with Martin & Chapman Company, Temporary Positions for Election Assistance and Support Services From Los Angeles County, and an Appropriation of Funds Thereof
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider and approve the proposed professional services agreements with Gladwell Governmental Services Inc. (Amendment #1), and Martin & Chapman Company, as well as approve the costs for election support services from Los Angeles County and the costs of precinct workers. It is further recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R17-42 defining and approving the hire of a Temporary Elections Assistant position, and Resolution R17-43 appropriating the funds for the described services, and adjusting the fiscal year 2017-18 budget.
Staff Report
